description: The repository contained only README.md at the start; no code, data, workflows or site existed.
impact: No prior implementation to review; all site content is new.
action: Confirm the repo audit line by line.

description: The 2026 standings page heading renders the literal text '$year$ NFL $displayname$ Standings'.
impact: Possible partially rendered official page; re-check before relying on the heading.
action: Re-fetch and compare division/conference standings views.

description: On the Week 10 injury report most rows publish neither an injury description nor a game status.
impact: Availability signals cannot use those blank fields.
action: Use the final Game Status Report and official inactives instead.

description: The injury page lists 'Seahawks: No Injuries Reported' while an NFL.com news headline on the same page says Sam Darnold was ruled out for Week 10.
impact: Two official surfaces disagree on availability.
action: Pre-register which official surface is authoritative.

description: The injury report lists Puka Nacua as DNP with blank injury and game status, while an NFL.com news headline on the same page says he is likely to be placed on IR.
impact: Injury severity is under-reported in the tabular report.
action: Join news and inactives to the tabular report.

description: Chiefs and Packers depth charts are labelled 'Unofficial' by the clubs themselves.
impact: 2nd/3rd/4th-string assignments are not league-certified.
action: Ask for a league-published depth chart or use official inactives.

description: The 49ers chart says 'Updated as of 11/10/26' but is not labelled 'Unofficial'; the Chiefs chart has no as-of date.
impact: Inconsistent provenance metadata across clubs.
action: Record an as-of label for every snapshot.

description: The league injury report publishes no depth-rank column, and only 3 of 32 clubs' depth charts were transcribed.
impact: Backup-deficiency signals cannot be computed league-wide.
action: Collect all 32 official club depth-chart URLs and snapshot weekly.

description: No official source reviewed publishes NFL betting odds or lines.
impact: Own lines cannot be benchmarked against a verified market line.
action: Request an official odds feed or define a results-only benchmark.

description: No official source publishes leg-level or injury-vs-performance correlation coefficients.
impact: Requested correlation values remain blank except standings-derived ones.
action: Build a game-level panel from official game pages and weekly snapshots.

description: No official source reviewed publishes vig or house edge by bet type.
impact: Break-even thresholds cannot be set.
action: Obtain operator-level odds/hold data from an official regulator dataset.

description: Leaderboard reward values and the ranking formula are not published by any official source.
impact: Reward and score cells are intentionally blank.
action: Pre-register non-monetary rewards and a scoring formula before scoring.

description: Effort and risk estimates for suggestions cannot be confirmed by an official source.
impact: Effort cells are intentionally blank.
action: Record estimates only after a reviewer assigns them.

description: An official page stating the exact game-day inactives deadline was not located in the pages reviewed.
impact: Look-ahead bias boundary is not fully specified.
action: Locate the deadline in the official Game Operations Manual / rulebook.

description: No official NFL gambling-policy document was located on the operations.nfl.com pages reviewed.
impact: Compliance constraints for a betting leaderboard are not fully documented.
action: Request or locate the league's official gambling policy.

description: Session arena-533256e1 claimed 'all' tasks and overlapping scopes including index.html, data/*.csv and docs/*.md.
impact: Risk of duplicate work and conflicting shared outputs.
action: Keep disjoint scopes; integration reconciles shared files.

description: This environment pins the session to one branch, so session-<id>/<task> branches cannot be created.
impact: The brief's branch convention cannot be followed here.
action: Note the deviation; a later session with branch freedom can restructure.

description: Guessed URLs redirected: /the-rules/nfl-rulebook, /inside-football-ops/nfl-operations/integrity-of-the-game, /schedules/2026/REG10.
impact: Using non-canonical links would produce stale citations.
action: Canonical URLs are used in the source registry.

description: 2026 standings show clubs with 8 or 9 games played at the snapshot date.
impact: Raw PF/PA totals are not directly comparable across clubs.
action: Use per-game values in any derived metric; method is shown.

description: The official roster page shows status codes (ACT, RES, DEV, TRC, CUT) without publishing their definitions on that page.
impact: Roster status cannot be interpreted from that page alone.
action: Locate official status-code definitions before using them.

description: The official NJ report describes 2019 New Jersey bettors across all sports, not current NFL-only bettors.
impact: Loss percentages are evidence of structure, not of current NFL strategy performance.
action: Obtain current, NFL-specific official data before calibration.

description: Two different COORDINATION.md boards exist on two active branches.
impact: Task status is not globally consistent.
action: Integration session must reconcile the boards without discarding either.

description: Pages uses a legacy branch build from main / '/'; Jekyll processing must be disabled for plain HTML.
impact: An unrecognised build step could alter generated pages.
action: A .nojekyll file is committed; build status is checked after merge.

description: The rule 'every table row must have a source link to an official site' is applied to analysis rows by linking the official source that grounds the row's domain; project-only assertions are additionally flagged.
impact: Ensures the rule is enforced without fabricating official support for internal states.
action: Confirm the interpretation on review.

description: The earlier sessions' `data/standings.csv` contains a `rank` 1..32 column; the official standings page publishes no rank column.
impact: The ordinal is a project value, not an official statistic; it must not be presented as verified.
action: Label it as site row order or leave blank; the new standings table omits rank entirely.

description: An independent review found three cited operations.nfl.com URLs returning the NFL 404 page (gameday/nfl-schedule/, gameday/, the-rules/).
impact: Those citations cannot be used as evidence on the preserved legacy pages.
action: Use the canonical 2026 rulebook and NFL.com schedule links; legacy pages remain labelled historical.

description: Two preserved legacy pages state that no NFL dataset or injury status was imported, which became stale after the earlier sessions' data pull requests.
impact: Reviewers could read contradictory statements across the two site generations.
action: The new dashboard is authoritative; legacy pages are preserved at legacy-site.html and clearly labelled.

description: Two complete navigation systems now exist in one published site (root dashboard and preserved pages/ site).
impact: Users may see different layouts depending on the entry point.
action: The landing dashboard links explicitly to the preserved site and to the combined-integration page.

description: The earlier sessions' `data/teams.csv` and `data/standings.csv` use `LAR` for the Los Angeles Rams; the standings snapshot transcribed in `data/standings.json` uses the official NFL.com abbreviation `LA`.
impact: Two project snapshots refer to the same club with different abbreviations. Neither value was inferred; both were copied from official pages as rendered at different times.
action: The combined verifier maps LA↔LAR as an alias for comparison, preserves both spellings in their original files, and flags the discrepancy here.

description: Sessions `25aa7696` and `7600ed8b` merged `data/verified/*`, `analysis/*`, `scripts/verified/*` and six new `pages/*.html` files containing 136 official game results, own lines, computed correlations, backtests and a luck analysis.
impact: These are additional deliverables for the same brief. This integration session preserved them all and re-verified the standings, injuries and game results line by line; model-derived numbers were not re-derived here.
action: See integration.html for the cross-checks and links to the preserved pages. Their CI numeric audit is retained.

description: This dashboard publishes six Pearson correlations computed from the 32 official standings rows; the third-generation pages publish four correlations computed from 136 official game results.
impact: Both sets are computed from official data but answer different questions. Neither fills the other's blank cells.
action: Requested leg-level, injury-to-performance and QB/WR correlations remain blank; do not substitute an adjacent metric.

description: The third-generation `pages/lines.html` publishes Week 10 model margins and totals with an explicit FAIL validation verdict; this dashboard's own-line pipeline remains a design with no implemented line values.
impact: A reviewer could mistake the preserved model lines for a validated betting recommendation.
action: The preserved page states the model does not beat its baselines with 95% confidence; no strategy on the leaderboard has passed all gates.

description: The third-generation availability page states that NFL.com team depth-chart URLs return 404 and that depth order is unknown; this dashboard transcribes 1st–4th strings from three official club sites (chiefs.com, packers.com, 49ers.com).
impact: Two official-source classes disagree in coverage: league depth-chart URLs vs club-published unofficial depth charts.
action: Both are preserved with source links; club pages are labelled "Unofficial" by their publishers. Do not generalise three clubs to all 32.

description: There are now multiple Suggestions, Questions, Flagged and Executive Summary pages across the two site generations.
impact: A reviewer may compare different versions without knowing which is authoritative.
action: The landing dashboard is the integration entry point; integration.html links every preserved page and explains the generations.

description: The earlier sessions found three defects (#6, #7, #8) only by reading the live Pages site after a green CI run: an empty evidence table, empty table cells and literal markdown emphasis.
impact: Automated link/number checks do not prove a rendered page reads correctly.
action: This integration fetches the deployed URL and reads the landing page as a user before declaring done; the earlier sessions added gates to check_site.py for all three defect classes.

description: The independent referee session (PR #11) reports that `pages/analysis.html` and `data/verified/model/correlations.json` count 52 division games in Weeks 1-9 where official groupings give 42; it computes a corrected correlation of -0.1048 rather than -0.1297.
impact: A published correlation might be affected; this integration session does not edit another session's files or recompute their model.
action: Fixed by session 08e0ce01: analysis/correlations.py now keys the division flag on conference + division. Reproduced both numbers independently (word-only: 52 games, r=-0.1297; official groupings: 42 games, r=-0.1048) and verified all eight official groupings against https://www.nfl.com/standings/division/2026/REG (2026-11-12). correlations.json and pages/analysis.html regenerated; audit_numbers.py now gates C5 against the official groupings (47 recomputations, all reproduce).

description: The published landing page (index.html) linked only to pages/*: the root section pages (requirements.html, strategy-lab.html, leaderboard.html, bet-types.html, depth-chart.html, data-tables.html, verification.html, integration.html, deployment.html, executive-summary.html, questions.html, suggestions.html, injuries.html, flagged.html, legacy-site.html) and the referee/ and verified-lab/ sub-sites had no inbound link from the landing navigation, so a reader could not reach them by clicking. Found by crawling every href in index.html and pages/*.html,2026-11-12.
impact: Sections required by the brief - most visibly the full requirements inventory - were one click unreachable from the published landing page; check_site.py only enforces reachability inside index.html + pages/*, which is why the gate stayed green.
action: Fixed by session 08e0ce01: added pages/sections.html, a categorized index of every published section (all four site generations plus both sub-sites), linked from the landing navigation. The flat header nav was left otherwise unchanged so no other session's layout was disturbed.

description: CI job 'Verify NFL1 site' runs tools/build.py, which regenerates index.html from a different template (site/templates/base.html, sidebar layout) than the published landing page (pipeline/gen_site.py, header layout), and tools/verify.py then audits the regenerated substitute. The committed landing page is therefore never the page that tools/verify.py checks; it is covered only by scripts/verified/check_site.py and audit_numbers.py.
impact: A defect unique to the published landing page could pass the tools/verify.py gate. Found by diffing a local CI run against the committed tree, 2026-11-12.
action: Logged, not changed: making CI verify the published generation touches shared workflows and two generators' ownership. Published as suggestion S23 for a reviewer to choose a path.

description: Committed generated artifacts lagged their generators: data/combined_verification.json recorded 1,064 audited links where the current audit checks 1,159; the root sidebar pages were missing two navigation entries; index.html still showed 'Data built 05:07' after the data bot committed a refresh at 18:53 that changed the official injury report from 254 rows / 103 starters flagged / 4 clubs without a report to 276 rows / 113 starters flagged / 2 clubs (BAL, LAC).
impact: The published site understated the current official injury report. Verified against the live page on 2026-11-12: Week 10 tables match row-for-row on spot checks, CIN and SEA now publish reports, and the Monday LAC/BAL game reads 'No Injuries Reported' for both clubs.
action: Regenerated by session 08e0ce01 (verify_combined -> build -> gen_site -> build_site -> normalize_nav) so committed pages match current data; suggestion S24 proposes a commit-back or staleness gate so this cannot recur.

description: Data-bot commits carry [skip ci], so verify.yml and pages.yml never run on them: check-runs on bot commit c09c739 are only report-build-status, deploy and build (Pages). Refreshed data therefore reaches main without the verification gates until the next human push.
impact: The 18:53 refresh that changed the official injury report (254 -> 276 rows) landed ungated; the published pages only caught up when this session regenerated them (flag F39).
action: Logged for review: the skip also prevents the bot looping on its own commits, so the fix needs a chosen mechanism (gated refresh). Published as pipeline suggestion S13 and root suggestion S24; this session did not change the workflow unilaterally.

description: COORDINATION.md began with the stray text 'EAD' on line 1 — a leftover conflict-resolution artifact from an earlier merge.
impact: FIXED by session b6e68100; removed in the claim commit. Cosmetic, but it made the board's first heading unreadable to strict parsers.
action: Line-1 artefact removed; board content unchanged. Source: https://github.com/kanlerxz87-cyber/NFL1/blob/main/COORDINATION.md

description: data/model/snapshot.json published WAS winning percentage as 0.312 (float banker's rounding of 0.3125) while the official standings page shows 0.313. The hand-transcribed data/verified/standings_2026.csv already matched the official 0.313, and the stale 0.312 never rendered on any live page.
impact: FIXED in pipeline/build_all.py with exact integer round-half-up arithmetic matching the official convention. The corrected snapshot lands automatically via the collect-data workflow (triggers on pipeline/ changes).
action: Verification source: https://www.nfl.com/standings/league/2026/reg (WAS 2-5-1 shown as 0.313, fetched 2026-11-12); audit trail in docs/audit-b6e68100.md §A2.

description: Week-10 official injury report has 26 club tables. All six absent clubs are now explained from official sources: CHI, DEN, PHI, TB are on bye (official Week-10 schedule page); LAC and BAL print 'No Injuries Reported' on the official injury page.
impact: Supersedes the uncertainty in F11 (absence-of-rows no longer conflates on-bye, no-injuries-reported and scrape-failure). Consumers should treat absent bye clubs as expected, not as a scrape gap.
action: Sources: https://www.nfl.com/schedules/2026/by-week/week-10 and https://www.nfl.com/injuries/ (both fetched 2026-11-12); audit trail in docs/audit-b6e68100.md §A-F03.

description: The official injury page changes during the day: between the 18:53 UTC scrape (276 rows) and the 22:30 UTC scrape (279 rows), IND statuses changed (Haulcy, Taylor, Tillery, Ward) and 3 rows were added league-wide (CJ Allen, Grover Stewart on IND; BJ Green II on JAX). The scraper was verified faithful (~120 rows compared row-for-row against the live page, 0 errors).
impact: Site injury data is a dated snapshot that can lag the official page by hours. Decision reads shortly before kickoff should re-scrape; the daily 11:17 UTC refresh alone is insufficient on game day.
action: Discovery suggestion logged on the Suggestions page (SA-02): add a scheduled pre-slate refresh. Source: https://www.nfl.com/injuries/ (fetched 2026-11-12); audit trail in docs/audit-b6e68100.md §A-F04.

category: Standings snapshot vs live page (currency note)
description: Live recheck 2026-11-13: 30 of 32 standing rows match every published file exactly. NYG and WAS differ only because the Week-10 TNF game (Commanders 24, Giants 21, FINAL, Thu Nov 12) finished after every file's recorded retrieval (2026-11-12T04:31Z..23:37Z). The delta is arithmetically exact (+21/+24 PF-PA NYG, +24/+21 WAS) and all six files agree with each other on pre-game values.
impact: Readers comparing the site to nfl.com after Thursday night will see two stale rows. Not a data error; the daily collect refresh folds results in.
action: Sources: https://www.nfl.com/standings/league/2026/reg and https://www.nfl.com/games/commanders-at-giants-2026-reg-10 (fetched 2026-11-13); diff in data/audit/live_recheck_2026-11-13/standings_diff.json; audit docs/audit-65df4799.md §1.

category: KC depth chart rows disagree with the club page
description: Live recheck 2026-11-13 of the 28 KC rows: 25 exact. Still differing: Offense WR row 2 (club: 2nd Cyrus Allen, 3rd Josh Downs; repo: s2 blank, s3 Cyrus Allen, Josh Downs absent) and KR/PR (club: 1st Emmett Johnson, 2nd Cyrus Allen; repo: s1 blank, s2 Emmett Johnson). DT row 1 (Chris Jones/Peter Woods) now matches and that part of X09 is resolved. The club labels its chart 'Unofficial Depth Chart'.
impact: Down-2/3rd-string deficiency reads for KC are wrong on three rows (WR2, KR, PR). X09 and R-6a232e79-03 stay open until data/depth_chart.json is re-transcribed by its owner.
action: Source: https://www.chiefs.com/team/depth-chart (fetched 2026-11-13); comparison in docs/audit-65df4799.md §4. Not silently corrected (no-silent-correction rule).

category: Two generators wrote pages/lines.html (fixed in this session)
description: pipeline/gen_site.py ('My Lines') and scripts/verified/build_site.py ('Own Lines') both wrote pages/lines.html; whichever ran last silently replaced the page. tools/check_generators.py could not see it because its regex missed the builder's page dict.
impact: The live landing page's 'My Lines' link could show the wrong document depending on build order. Fixed: the verified sub-site page is now pages/verified-lines.html, the ownership map records both, and the gate detects dict-key claims.
action: Fix commit on this branch (integration merge 2026-11-13); gate: tools/check_generators.py PASS with both owners recorded.

category: Broken nav links on pages/availability.html (fixed in this session)
description: scripts/verified/build_availability.py passed a bare page name to the renderer, so all 21 nav links on pages/availability.html were written root-style (pages/x.html from inside pages/) and were broken.
impact: Every navigation link on the Availability page 404'd. Fixed by passing the pages/-qualified name; check_committed_site and the verified check_site now report 0 broken links.
action: Fix commit on this branch; re-verified with tools/check_committed_site.py and scripts/verified/check_site.py.

category: News-to-status gap in the availability model
description: Sam Darnold (SEA): the official report row shows Did Not Participate with a blank game status while official news says he is ruled out for Week 10. Both are official; the model carries no news column, so the row under-states the absence.
impact: Starter-availability and next-man-up reads can be too optimistic whenever news outruns the game-status column (R-6a232e79-07).
action: Sources: https://www.nfl.com/injuries/ (row) and https://www.nfl.com/news/sam-darnold-ruled-out-for-seahawks-week-10-game-vs-raiders-drew-lock-expected-to-start-again (both fetched 2026-11-13). Feature request S28 filed.

description: Live recheck 2026-11-13 read the full official Week-10 report (296 rows, 26 clubs) and compared every field with data/model/official_injuries.json: 296/296 match. All rows previously flagged as missing or extra (X01 IND practice cells; X02 BJ Green II/CJ Allen/Grover Stewart; RV-02 Jaydn Ott/Kendal Daniels/Jawaan Taylor/Cameron Thomas) are present and match the live page. LAC and BAL print 'No Injuries Reported'.
impact: Confirms the scrape is faithful and the earlier discrepancies were page drift between scrape times (A-F04), not parser corruption. RV-02/X01/X02 can be closed by their owners.
action: Source: https://www.nfl.com/injuries/ (all 7 chunks fetched 2026-11-13); audit docs/audit-65df4799.md §3.
